title: Gold Sun Regen
description: Golden armor and tools repair in direct sunlight.
body:
**Gold Sun Regen** gives vanilla golden armor and tools a reason to wear — they slowly repair themselves while exposed to direct sunlight.
Stand outside on a clear day and your damaged gold gear will regain durability over time. The effect is strongest at **midday**, weaker at **dawn and dusk**, and stops in rain, shade, or underground.

Notice: This mod was created using AI, do not use if that bothers you. 

## What repairs
All vanilla golden gear is supported:
- Helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots
- Sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe
Works on **worn armor**, **held tools**, and **dropped items** lying in the sun.

## How it works
- Repair only happens during the **day** with a clear view of the sky
- **Rain and storms** block repair
- Standing in **water** still works if your head is in open sunlight
- Repair is **slower by default** and scales with the sun's position in the sky
- **Dropped golden items** can repair on the ground, with an optional orbiting glow and soft resonance hum

## Visual & audio effects
Optional client effects while repairing:
- Sunlight particles that drift inward toward repairing gear
- A gentle resonating hum on players and dropped items
- Particle count scales with time of day (more at midday)
All effects can be turned off in config.

## Configuration
Open **Mods → Gold Sun Regen → Config** to customize:
- Repair speed and check interval
- Midday repair amount
- Sun-position scaling
- Dropped item repair
- Particles and resonance
- Overworld-only mode
- Minimum sunlight brightness

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- **NeoForge** 21.1.233+

No new items or blocks — this mod only changes how vanilla golden gear behaves.
